description: Where a held send stands, by its `draft_id`: `pending` until a person approves or rejects it in the dashboard, then `approved` (it was sent, and `message_id` is the message), `rejected`, or `expired` after 24 hours with nobody deciding. You cannot approve it yourself. Check again after a while rather than in a loop, and tell the person you are working for that it is waiting.
name: get_draft_approval
title: Check a send that is waiting for approval
